source.BSD68: 68 grayscale test images (Berkeley Segmentation Dataset), as distributed in https://github.com/cszn/DnCNN (testsets/BSD68).
source.BSD400: 400 grayscale 180x180 training images (Berkeley Segmentation Dataset), as distributed in https://github.com/cszn/DnCNN (TrainingCodes/DnCNN_TrainingCodes_v1.0/data/Train400). Academic use; cite Martin et al. 2001 (BSDS).

preprocessing: Grayscale (PIL convert('L')), uint8 -> float32 /255 in [0,1]. No resizing or cropping. Originals untouched.

selection_rule.calibration: 8 of the 68 BSD68 images, drawn without replacement with default_rng(SeedSequence([20260, 1])); remaining 60 are test.
selection_rule.validation: 20 of the 400 BSD400 images, drawn without replacement with default_rng(SeedSequence([20260, 2])); remaining 380 are train.
selection_rule.index: 0-based position of the file in the lexicographically sorted list within a dataset.
